settings.text: A few minutes of care keeps the smooth panels clean and the textured overlays rich for years. Here is how to look after your pair.

settings.heading: Before first wear
settings.row_content: Apply a water and stain protector spray to the textured overlays from 20 cm away, and let it dry for 24 hours. If you use shoe trees, put them in the evening you bring your pair home.

settings.heading: Smooth panels
settings.row_content: For the smooth upper of The Silent Grind and A Fresh Start. Wipe with a soft, dry cloth after wear. Every few months, clean with a little neutral shoe cleaner and buff gently.

settings.heading: Textured overlays
settings.row_content: For the textured toe, eyestay and collar of both models. Use a soft brush, always in one direction, to lift the nap. Lift marks with a gentle eraser; never soak the overlays. A Fresh Start's sand overlays benefit from a protector spray before first wear.

settings.heading: Midsoles & laces
settings.row_content: Clean the white cupsole with a damp cloth and a little mild soap; an eraser sponge lifts scuffs. Laces can be hand-washed and dried flat.

settings.heading: Storage
settings.row_content: Keep each pair in its dust bag, away from direct sunlight and heat. Shoe trees help it keep its shape. Keep the box: its label carries your pair's number.

settings.heading: Repairs & questions
settings.row_content: Write to us with your pair's serial (printed under the QR tag) and we will advise on care and next steps.
